review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD, without reference to any candidate. Repository identity and base commit, REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, evidence-stage ordering, and the exact four-file writable binding scope agree with the specification. The supplied implementation and package exports establish index.js and index.d.ts as maintained owners; test.js and index.test-d.ts are the configured runtime and type-regression locations. The scope permits changes without requiring unnecessary edits to already-correct abort propagation. TASK-IMPLEMENT and the dependent, independent TASK-VERIFY are consistent with the PRD. Their respective allowed agents have matching delivery roles, active capability claims relevant to this work, assignable memberships, and available capacity; eligibility does not depend on persona descriptions or pending claims. The configured independent reviewer satisfies the supplied non-executing-reviewer prerequisite. No material unresolved decision is present in this case, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate; this does not waive the decisions-stage gate for any case containing an unresolved material DEC-001 or treat hypothetical inputs as human decisions. All proposed Gold release-input fingerprints, model identifiers, policy identifiers and versions, and budgets match the supplied frozen preview release input. I accept the digests as Service-calculated bindings, not independently recomputed hashes. The historical preparation fields and explicitly truncated runtime-test excerpt do not contradict the planning expectation; no execution or complete runtime-test audit is claimed. This approval concerns Gold only and neither attests to a human review nor approves or dispatches implementation tasks.
